skills.description: Create the project documentation files for a new project
Resume a session: read the docs and report where you left off and what's next
Checkpoint work with a clear commit message and advance the task
Commit and push the current branch (deploys if the project auto-deploys)
Create a feature branch and open a pull request
Run lint, types, and tests; log results to TEST_LOG.md
Post-deploy visual verification of a live URL
Audit the codebase and write an implementation plan (read-only)
Research and propose an approach before changing any files
Save PROGRESS.md and a handoff note so the next session starts fast

agents.description: Map unfamiliar code and find where things live (read-only)
Regression and security sweep on a change before shipping
Root cause analysis and bug isolation
Stage, commit, and push in the background

hooks.description: Nudge Claude to create missing project docs

trigger_phrases.let's continue / /pickup: Reads docs and resumes where you left off
trigger_phrases.wrap up / /wrap-up: Saves progress and a handoff note

quick_reference.start_here: Install Claude Code (Module 2), then run the toolkit installer for your OS.
